hubTrigger.claim: Brent fell below USD35 while the yuan weakened to a five-year low, creating opposing airline cost and FX effects.
The yuan rebounded sharply after policy support, partially relieving FX pressure while oil remained low versus prior-year levels.

evidence.claim: Fuel cost fell 30.36% YoY to RMB26.274bn and attributable profit rose 117.2%; operating cash flow rose 70.1%.
FX loss reached RMB5.702bn, up sharply from RMB276m, showing currency could offset a large portion of fuel-cost relief.
2015 attributable profit rose 77.45%; company identified low oil prices and strong international-route growth as major positives, while FX losses remained material.

preliminaryDisposition: Research only if price absorption is low and the combined fuel-plus-FX asymmetry remains positive; otherwise No selection.
